verdict.rationale: AMD's own product page documents AV1 encode/decode support (amd-rx-9070-xt-docs-8), satisfying part of the media-engine claim, but there is no mention of HEVC encode/decode capability, nor any evidence of ISV/professional certification (e.g., for DaVinci Resolve, Adobe apps, or Radeon Pro workstation drivers) for the RX 9070 XT specifically. Missing for 10: HEVC encoder/decoder specs, creator-app (Premiere/DaVinci/Resolve) acceleration details, and ISV-certified driver documentation.
